title: Subtree of Another Tree
prompt: Given the roots of two binary trees root and subRoot, return true if there is a subtree of root with the same structure and node values of subRoot and false otherwise. A subtree includes a node and all of its descendants.
hints: For each node in root, check if the tree starting at that node matches subRoot. Use isSameTree as a helper.
If root is null, return false (subRoot is non-empty). If current node matches subRoot (isSameTree), return true.
Otherwise recursively check isSubtree(root.left, subRoot) || isSubtree(root.right, subRoot).
O(m * n) worst case - for each of m nodes we may compare up to n nodes.
